Decentralised inference at scale

Apex Labs operates a Bittensor subnet where miners compete to serve large language model inference with low latency and verifiable quality. Validators score every response against reference outputs and reward the fastest accurate miners.

Our network served more than forty million requests last month across text, code and image models. Developers integrate through an OpenAI-compatible API, and enterprises can reserve dedicated capacity with service-level guarantees.

The team has shipped weekly releases since launch and publishes every scoring change in the open repository, together with benchmark results and incident reports.
